mapper.select: select t.dept_id id, t.parent_id pid, d.dept_name as label from sys_dept_diagram t left join sys_dept d ON t.dept_id = d.dept_id where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by t.parent_id, t.dept_id

with recursive tree (dept_id, parent_id) as (select t1.dept_id, t1.parent_id from sys_dept_diagram t1 where dept_id = #{deptId} union select t2.dept_id, t2.parent_id from sys_dept_diagram t2 join tree on t2.parent_id = tree.dept_id) select distinct tree.dept_id from tree JOIN sys_dept u on tree.dept_id = u.dept_id
